clouds: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a standalone transparent parallax layer for a cute 2D browser swimming game. Image 1, the DUCK SPRITE SHEET, is the AUTHORITATIVE ART STYLE reference: thick smooth dark navy outlines, simple rounded shapes, clean flat/cel shading, very restrained warm highlights, cheerful playful cartoon proportions, no painterly detail. Image 2 is only reference for tropical theme and colour family, DO NOT match its painterly rendering. All scenery must look hand-drawn by the same artist as the outlined duck. Create landscape PNG 1536x1024 with real transparent alpha. Every object fully contained, leave minimum 60 pixels of fully transparent empty margin on BOTH horizontal edges for clean repeat wrapping. Keep a common flat baseline precisely at y=680 pixels; all pixels below baseline transparent. Entire background transparent, no sky or sea fill, no haze, gradients outside silhouettes, glow, cast shadows, reflections, typography, watermark, character or UI. Simple game-ready raster illustration with dark navy contour outlines, rounded stroke joins, clean silhouette edges, restrained 2-tone shading INSIDE shapes. ONLY CLOUD LAYER: several separated clusters of fluffy white and pale ice-blue clouds, cute simple scalloped silhouettes with smooth navy outlines somewhat thinner/lighter than duck. Clusters near left and right thirds and one small low cluster near center, with transparent gaps between them, tops between y=370 and y=550 and bottom at y=680. Simplified icon-like cloud lobes, minimal pale blue underside shading, no atmospheric billowing realism. No island, palms, rocks, mountains, water or any other objects.
